thread:
Devin: Morning — quick async update from me. What I did: finished the routing policy merge for header-based tenant split; verified with a small canary in us-east. Blockers: seeing occasional 502s when JWTs are rotated. Today: triage token rotation fallout, tap in on the rate-limit config PR.
Anya: Nice. For the 502s — are they after auth service pushes? I saw some userinfo 503s in the logs earlier.
Devin: yep around 08:12 deploy. Logs show downstream auth returning 503 -> gateway retries -> 502 to client. snippet: ```http
POST /auth/userinfo 503
```
Liam: I can revert the auth deploy if needed. Quick q: what's the current global rate bucket? 120r/s, 150, or 200? I thought we landed on ~150.
Priya: it's 150 for public routes, 300 for internal. We did a temporary bump yesterday: `rbac-route` override set to 200 for a short window.
Devin: Can we confirm per-tenant overrides aren't misapplied? I pushed a debug endpoint to staging: `/__debug/rate` returns the effective bucket. @Liam can you hit it and paste response? :mag:
Liam: hit it — `{"tenant":"acme","limit":200,"window":"1s"}`. So override is present for that tenant.
Anya: Also noticed the JWT rotation job didn't refresh the edge cache keys — TTL mismatch. I'm going to add an explicit cache-refresh call on rotation.
Devin: Good. Blocker for me is auth team's confirmation + a temp fallback policy to route to secondary auth cluster. @infra-bot if you can spin fallback route, that helps.
infra-bot: deploy request accepted — creating route policy `auth-fallback` in us-east-1; attaching to gateway-2. ETA ~8m. :robot_face:
Priya: FYI I'm mid-CR review on the rate-limit protobuf change, left comments on backoff logic. Could be blocking if schema needs updates.
Devin: Plan: 1) Anya add key-refresh, 2) infra-bot attach fallback, 3) Liam hold rollback on standby, 4) Priya finish CR. I'll re-check in ~30m unless someone calls it done.
Liam: on standby. :thumbsup:
Priya: 👍
Anya: on it — will post logs once key refresh is live.
Devin: thanks team — I'll tag followups in the related PRs and the deployment ticket. /me out
